subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should forced cookie re-import extend `codexbar cache clear --cookies` or become a separate permanent `codexbar cookie refresh` command?
rationale: Both shapes are plausible, but landing both overlapping workflows without an intentional CLI contract would create long-term behavioral and documentation drift.

options.title: Extend cache clear
options.body: Add an opt-in re-import flag to the existing cache command and route all providers through one shared refresh implementation.

options.title: Keep cookie refresh
options.body: Retain the new namespace only after implementing truthful provider-wide result semantics and documenting its distinction from cache clearing.

options.title: Document two commands
options.body: Close this implementation and document cache clearing followed by a normal usage fetch as the supported recovery workflow.

recommendation.title: Extend cache clear
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in re-import flag to the existing cache command and route all providers through one shared refresh implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice defines the repository's permanent CLI and credential-management product surface.
